description: The close outcome is folded as tasks complete, not only at the close. r.side holds t.fast (sleeps to 10) and t.slow (sleeping to 1000). Read at 5 (driver observation, step 1) nothing has completed: ASX_E_NOT_FOUND. The driver cancels the unrelated t.m at 15 (its sleep is not a cancellation point: the cancel only makes it runnable) so that the next entry's idle run takes a step, which fires t.fast's due timer; read at 20 (step 3) the outcome is already Ok, with t.slow still pending and the region open. The driver then closes the region with a User cancel at 30, t.slow is cancelled, and read at 40 (step 5) the outcome is Cancelled (User, origin r.side, stamped 30): the join of t.fast's Ok and t.slow's Cancelled. t.m is declared first so that the metamorphic no-op, which joins the first task's region, completes in r.main and not in the observed region: a task that completes in r.side changes the first read from ASX_E_NOT_FOUND to Ok.
